confirmation_blocks.rule: per family and level, seeds in increasing order fill H1, then H2, then H3 with these counts

group: base problem id; encoding/flip/perm variants and solver-seed repeats follow their base
dedupe: sha256, canonical (clause-set) and renaming-invariant hashes against all v8-v11 generated instances and the v9/v10 SATLIB externals; a duplicate is replaced by the next seed (reported)

encoding_diagnostic.base: discovery, per family and level the first 2 seeds (48)

solver_seeds.base: discovery, per family and level the first seed (24)

training_pool: discovery + development (528), grouped by base problem
